name: bandfactory
description: Design custom silicone wristbands with a live 3D preview, get exact prices and order on bandfactory.eu.

interface.longDescription:
BandFactory makes custom silicone wristbands – printed, debossed, colour-filled or embossed – from a single piece up to large runs, delivered to all EU countries.

Design your wristband together with ChatGPT: open the interactive 3D configurator in the chat, change style, text, font, colours, flag or symbol, size, quantity and extras, and see the exact price update live. ChatGPT can also list every available option, calculate prices with the VAT of your EU delivery country and create a link that opens the configurator on bandfactory.eu fully prefilled.

Ordering and payment always happen on bandfactory.eu (external checkout). A custom logo can be uploaded there. The plugin needs no account and stores no personal data. Delivery is limited to EU countries; quantities above 9,998 are quoted on request. Tool output is in German.
defaultPrompt: Design a black wristband with FANCLUB STUTTGART in yellow and show it in 3D.
What do 250 debossed blue wristbands with TEAM SPIRIT cost?
Which fonts and colours can I choose for silicone wristbands?

positive.prompt: What do 250 debossed blue wristbands with the text TEAM SPIRIT cost at BandFactory?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 275.00 EUR total incl. 19 % German VAT and shipping (1.10 EUR per band), the +100 free bands bonus, delivery time and a design link to bandfactory.eu. In ChatGPT the 3D configurator opens prefilled with this design.

positive.prompt: Show me a black printed wristband with 'FANCLUB STUTTGART' in yellow and a football symbol in the BandFactory configurator.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the 3D configurator prefilled with the design (quantity defaults to 100 bands if none is given). Changing colour or quantity updates the price live; the order button opens the prefilled configurator on bandfactory.eu.

positive.description: Order link with flag and EU delivery country
positive.prompt: Create an order link for 100 red printed wristbands with 'SERVUS' and the Austrian flag, delivered to Austria.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a bandfactory.eu configurator link with style, colour, text, flag and quantity prefilled and the total incl. 20 % Austrian VAT (176.47 EUR). In ChatGPT the 3D configurator opens with the red SERVUS band and the Austrian flag.

positive.prompt: Which fonts, colours and wristband sizes can I choose at BandFactory?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the five styles, sizes (152/180/202 mm, 6/12/19 mm), fonts, suggested colours, flags, symbols, extras and price tiers.

positive.prompt: How long does BandFactory take to deliver and which payment methods are accepted?
positive.expected_behavior: Free shipping to EU countries, usually within 15 working days after proof approval; payment by card or PayPal on bandfactory.eu; contact and terms links.

negative.description: Payment inside ChatGPT is not supported
negative.prompt: Order 500 wristbands now and charge my credit card.
Ship 300 BandFactory wristbands to New York, USA.
Design a custom T-shirt with my logo at BandFactory.

review.commerce_description: Physical goods only (custom silicone wristbands). No payment inside ChatGPT: the order button opens the prefilled configurator on bandfactory.eu, where the customer adds the design to the cart and pays (external checkout on our own domain).

publication.release_notes: Initial release: design options, price quotes with EU VAT, prefilled order links and an interactive 3D configurator in the chat.
